subject: Error compiling knitr documents after updating R Studio and linux libs

messages.author: 59e24b23b6b00e9d
messages.subject: Error compiling knitr documents after updating R Studio and linux libs
parts:
Hi all,
After coming back from a holiday and updating R Studio (and a million other linux libs) I started getting this error when trying to compile knitr codes:

*** glibc detected *** /usr/lib/R/bin/exec/R: malloc(): memory corruption: 0x0000000012141550 ***

I get the error, in simple and complex docs alike.
I googled the error but couldn't find anything related or helpful.

Any suggestions?

Thanks in advance,
Roey

R version 2.15.1 (2012-06-22)
Platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu (64-bit)

locale:
 [1] LC_CTYPE=en_US.UTF-8       LC_NUMERIC=C               LC_TIME=en_US.UTF-8        LC_COLLATE=en_US.UTF-8     LC_MONETARY=en_US.UTF-8    LC_MESSAGES=en_US.UTF-8  
 [7] LC_PAPER=C                 LC_NAME=C                  LC_ADDRESS=C               LC_TELEPHONE=C             LC_MEASUREMENT=en_US.UTF-8 LC_IDENTIFICATION=C      

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] tools_2.15.1

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Error compiling knitr documents after updating R Studio and linux libs
parts:
As a first step to diagnose the problem, let's see if it is a problem
of knitr or purely RStudio: just open R in your terminal, and
library(knitr); knit('your_file'). If that crashes R too, it is my
problem.

Which version of RStudio are you using? And did you update.packages() in R?

Regards,
Yihui
